tools.name: list_platforms
tools.description:
List every platform Scraping Daddy ("SD") can scrape, with a short description.

Start here when the user asks SD for live data and the endpoint is not known yet.
Discovery only — this does not consume API credits.

tools.name: list_endpoints
tools.description: Find AM-CORE endpoints, optionally filtered by platform and/or a search term.

tools.name: get_endpoint_schema
tools.description: Return the full request and response schema for one AM-CORE endpoint.

tools.name: api_request
tools.description: Call any Scraping Daddy ("SD") endpoint and return its response unchanged.

tools.name: tiktok_video

tools.name: instagram_profile
tools.description: Get an Instagram profile: bio, follower counts, and account metadata.

tools.name: youtube_video

tools.name: x_profile

tools.name: google_maps_search
tools.description: Search places or select one by place_id/data. Offsets advance by 20 (recommended maximum 100); later pages require ll. Only AM-CORE's supported domains/data filters are accepted.

tools.name: google_maps_place
tools.description: Get business details using at least one Google feature ID, place ID, or decimal CID. Multiple identifiers must agree.

findings.title: Toxic flow: untrusted input can reach an external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp.scrapingdaddy.com" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: tiktok_video, instagram_media, reddit_search, youtube_video, x_profile, x_tweets, x_tweet · Public sink: tiktok_video, instagram_media, x_tweets, x_tweet.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: tiktok_video, instagram_media, reddit_search, youtube_video, x_profile, x_tweets, x_tweet · Public sink: tiktok_video, instagram_media, x_tweets, x_tweet

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
